adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, the refactor changes `bookingCalendarReference` to an array and loops `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`. Inside that loop, when `credentialId` is present but not found in `bookingToDelete.user.credentials`, it does `await prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })`. This is a per-reference DB lookup performed sequentially, which is a classic N+1/per-item query pattern introduced/exposed by the new loop. A batch fetch (e.g., `findMany` on all missing credentialIds) would avoid repeated round trips. This is a performance/scalability concern rather than a correctness defect.
